description: Counter staff create the ticket, record the device and fault, capture consent and the passcode in the restricted field when the repair needs it, and quote the repair
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Intake is the front door for about 740 store devices a day; without tickets devices cannot be tracked, which risks mix-ups and lost customer property; 8 hours is most of one store day
manual_workaround: Pre-numbered paper intake forms with carbon copies; device bags labeled with the paper ticket number; passcodes not collected on paper (devices wait for the system); back-enter within 24 hours of restoration
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing and POS vendor; SD-WAN provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Customer service advisors; Store Managers; 34 stores
quantified_operational_impact: About 740 store intakes a day; paper intake takes about 2.5 times longer, so queues form at busy stores and about 40% of turned-away walk-ins do not return
quantified_regulatory_impact: None directly; paper forms with personal information must be locked and shredded after back-entry (Fla. Stat. 501.171(8))

description: Technicians diagnose, pull parts, repair, test, and update the ticket; parts pairing and calibration for Manufacturer A devices use its online tools
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Same-day repairs (screens, batteries) are about 60% of store volume; promised turnaround drives reviews; Manufacturer A pairing needs SYS-08
manual_workaround: Paper job cards; repairs that need no manufacturer tool continue; parts pulled from the printed daily stock list
dependent_third_parties: Manufacturer A and B tools; parts suppliers
quantified_operational_impact: About 600 store repairs a day; each 8 hours down pushes about 220 same-day repairs to the next day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Manufacturer A program terms on parts traceability by serial number must be met on paper and back-entered

description: Counter staff take payment on P2PE terminals, verify identity (photo ID or one-time code), and release the device
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payment carries about $151,600 of revenue a store day; releasing a device to the wrong person discloses the owner's data
manual_workaround: P2PE terminals run standalone for card payments; printed release checklist with photo ID check against the paper claim stub; hand invoices
quantified_operational_impact: About 700 releases a day; standalone terminals keep card payments running, but releases slow by about half without ticket lookup
quantified_regulatory_impact: SAQ P2PE eligibility: card numbers must never be written down during the workaround (PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.2.1)

business_process: Mail-in orders, checkout, and return shipping
description: Customers book mail-in repairs and pay deposits on the mail-in portal checkout page; the Depot receives parcels, opens tickets, and ships repaired devices back
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $29,000 of revenue a day; customers in other states rely on tracking; checkout page integrity is a PCI DSS concern as well as an availability one
manual_workaround: Portal shows a maintenance banner and phone number; contact center takes bookings and keys phone payments into P2PE terminals; Depot logs parcels on paper
dependent_people_or_facilities: Depot receiving staff; digital engineering team; contact center
quantified_operational_impact: About 100 mail-in orders a day; about 20% of orders not placed during an outage are lost
quantified_regulatory_impact: SAQ A eligibility depends on the checkout page staying free of unauthorized scripts (N81-R03)

business_process: Protection plan claims intake and status
description: The partner integration API receives claims from Partners P1 and P2, opens tickets, and posts status and repair outcomes back
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 120 claims a day ($51,600 of revenue a day); partner agreements expect claim acknowledgement within 4 business hours and repair within 5 business days (fictional terms); repeated misses put the partner relationship at risk
manual_workaround: Partners queue and replay claims for up to 72 hours; urgent claims by secure email and phone; status posted manually in the partner portals
dependent_third_parties: Partners P1 and P2; cloud provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Partner claims desk (Depot); digital engineering team
quantified_operational_impact: About 120 claims a day; manual handling covers about 30 urgent claims a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Partner agreements (contract); third-party agent breach notice duty if claim data is exposed (Fla. Stat. 501.171(6))

business_process: Depot repair (board-level, warranty, and partner claims)
description: Depot technicians repair mail-in, warranty, partner, and escalated store devices, including microsoldering
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Most Depot work is scheduled over days; parts pairing needs SYS-08; backlog grows by about 260 devices a day
manual_workaround: Paper job cards; work that needs no system continues; overtime to clear the backlog
quantified_operational_impact: About 260 Depot repairs a day; second shift absorbs about half a day of backlog

description: Submit warranty repairs, parts returns, and reimbursement claims in the manufacturer portals
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $54,800 of reimbursements a day; claims have submission windows of 5 business days in the program agreements (fictional term); late claims lose reimbursement
manual_workaround: Record claims in a spreadsheet and submit when the portal returns
quantified_operational_impact: About 150 warranty claims a day; 3 days of backlog clears in about 2 days of overtime
quantified_regulatory_impact: Manufacturer A agreement: parts traceability and claim windows (contract); about $164,400 of reimbursements delayed over 72 hours

description: Image failing drives and devices, recover files, and deliver data to customers by expiring link or encrypted drive
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Premium service with fixed quotes; some failing media can be read only once, so losing an image can mean the data is gone for good; recovered data is highly personal, so loss or exposure is a breach risk
manual_workaround: Pause new cases; keep drives sealed in the lab; tell customers of delays
quantified_operational_impact: About 25 cases a day; about 10% of delayed customers cancel
quantified_regulatory_impact: Exposure of recovered data is a likely breach under Fla. Stat. 501.171 and other states' laws (N81-R02)

description: Status texts and emails from SYS-01, the chatbot, and the customer status portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers call when updates stop; about 3,000 extra calls a day would swamp the contact center
manual_workaround: Website banner; chatbot turned off; stores call customers whose devices are ready
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing and POS vendor; chatbot vendor; SMS gateway (through the ticketing vendor)

business_process: Contact center (support, bookings, and phone payments)
description: Agents answer calls, book repairs, take mail-in phone payments on P2PE terminals, and handle complaints
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 2,400 calls a day; phone payments for mail-in repairs; call recordings and AI summaries (AI-003) must respect recording consent
manual_workaround: Calls forwarded to store phones and the overflow answering service; recordings and AI summaries off
dependent_third_parties: Contact center platform vendor; overflow answering service
quantified_operational_impact: About 2,400 calls a day; overflow service covers about 40% of volume
quantified_regulatory_impact: Fla. Stat. 934.03 recording consent applies to recorded calls; card numbers must not be written down by overflow staff (PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.2.1)

business_process: Business account service, field repair, and invoicing
description: Scheduled and on-site repairs for 520 business accounts, monthly invoices, ACH collection
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contracts promise turnaround times and data handling terms; invoices are monthly, so a short outage does not affect cash
manual_workaround: Track work on paper; field technicians use printed work orders; invoice late
dependent_people_or_facilities: 15 field technicians; Director of Business Accounts
quantified_regulatory_impact: Business account contracts set data handling and notice terms (contract)

description: Accept devices for recycling, sanitize or destroy storage per SP 800-88 Rev. 2, and hand lots to the certified recycler
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No revenue impact; devices can wait in locked bins; the risk is data exposure, not downtime
manual_workaround: Stop accepting drop-offs; keep bins locked and sealed
quantified_regulatory_impact: Disposal of customer records (Fla. Stat. 501.171(8)) must not be skipped during backlog

description: Forecast, order, receive, and allocate parts to 34 stores and the Depot
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Stores hold about 5 days of common parts; stockouts after 3 days stop screen and battery repairs
manual_workaround: Manual orders from the last stock report; emergency transfers between stores

business_process: Partner billing and claim settlement reconciliation
description: Invoice Partners P1 and P2 weekly from repair outcomes; reconcile settlements and disputes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow, not time, drives this process; repair outcome data must be complete and accurate because it drives partner settlement (processing integrity)
manual_workaround: Hold invoices; reconcile from ticket exports when restored
quantified_operational_impact: About $310,000 of partner invoices a week
quantified_regulatory_impact: Partner agreements: accurate repair outcome reporting (contract); about $258,000 of cash delayed over 5 days

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding and offboarding, background checks, and applicant screening
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; a missed payroll has legal and retention impact; offboarding delays leave access open
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider; offboarding by checklist from the HR Director
dependent_third_parties: Payroll and HR SaaS; background check vendor
quantified_operational_impact: About 600 employees; about 25 hires and 24 departures a month
quantified_regulatory_impact: Disposal Rule duties for background reports continue (16 CFR 682.3)

description: Daily store, Depot, partner, and finance reporting from the reporting database
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Management reporting can wait a week
manual_workaround: Standard reports from SYS-01 and the ERP
